newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime wins new RamRig order.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime wins new RamRig order.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services group Aker Maritime ASA said on Thursday Norwegian drilling contractor Dolphin had ordered a third RamRig drilling package from Aker subsidiary Maritime Hydraulics.
The sale brings the number of RamRig orders to the company to seven, with an aggregate value of more than 1.3 billion crowns, Aker Maritime said in a statement.
Aker said the new 180 million crown unit was essentially a copy of the drilling package ordered by Dolphin for the Borgland Dolphin semisubmersible rig two weeks ago.
The RamRig concept was developed by Maritime Hydraulics and made its commercial breakthrough in March 1996.

"Record sales since then, and the great interest we are now experiencing for the concept from drilling companies the world over, reinforces our belief that we have probably developed the leading drilling product of the decade," Per Moeller-Hansen, head of Maritime Hyraulics, said in a statement.
